details.description: GPT-4.1 is OpenAI's general-purpose model released April 14, 2025, which OpenAI describes as 'the smartest non-reasoning model,' built for coding, instruction following, and long-context tasks without a separate reasoning step. It accepts text and image input with text-only output, a context window up to 1,047,576 tokens, a 32,768-token output limit, and a knowledge cutoff of June 1, 2024. Azure's Foundry model catalog currently lists this version (2025-04-14) as 'Deprecated' -- still usable by existing customers but not available for new deployments -- with a retirement date of April 14, 2027.
advantages: Scores 54.6% on SWE-bench Verified per OpenAI's announcement, up from 33.2% for GPT-4o and 38% for GPT-4.5.
Scores 90.2% on the MMLU benchmark, per OpenAI's launch presentation.
OpenAI reports it more than doubles GPT-4o's score on Aider's polyglot diff benchmark, reaching 52.9% accuracy on code diffs across multiple languages.
Supports a context window up to 1 million tokens, over 8x the 128K context of prior GPT-4o models.
disadvantages: Non-reasoning model -- OpenAI positions it for low-latency, instruction-following use rather than step-by-step reasoning.
Azure's Foundry catalog currently lists this version as 'Deprecated': open to existing customers only, not available for new deployments.
Text-only output; does not generate images or audio.
use_cases: Long-context processing (up to 1M tokens), e.g. large codebases or document sets
General-purpose chat and vision (text+image input) tasks needing low latency
